title: artemisia laciniata subsp. parryi
intro: Artemisia laciniata subsp. parryi, commonly known as Silver Sage, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Silver Sage include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Silver Sage include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
